rule_set.title: ABS MVR Part 3 hull scantling checks used by MiDShip
rule_set.scope: Cargo-hold scantling checks for 25 MiDShip constraints. Not a full class approval.

abs_mvr_part3_jul23.title: Rules for Building and Classing Marine Vessels, Part 3: Hull Construction and Equipment
abs_mvr_part3_jul23.page_numbering: printed page numbers of the ABS PDF (PDF page minus 4)
abs_mvr_part3_jul23.note: MiDShip states it follows the July 2024 edition. The July 2023 edition is the nearest public PDF found. Paragraph numbers can differ between editions.

midship_evaluator.title: MiDShip Parametric_Structure_Eval.py (constraint evaluator)
midship_evaluator.note: Used to find which paragraphs and design-basis choices MiDShip applies. Not a rule source.

rules.title: Minimum double bottom depth

inputs.name: beam
inputs.description: Molded breadth B (twice the side shell offset).

inputs.name: draft
inputs.description: Scantling draft. MiDShip takes 0.6667 D.

inputs.name: db_height_mm
inputs.description: Actual double bottom height.

criterion.formula: max(32 B + 190 sqrt(d), min(B/20, 2000 mm), 760 mm)

rules.status_reason: MiDShip applies the B/20 and 0.76 m limits of 1.1.i to non-tankers only; the strict option applies them to all types.

rules.title: Minimum solid floor thickness

inputs.name: floor_t_mm
inputs.description: Actual floor thickness.

assumptions.name: scantling_length_m
assumptions.basis: MiDShip design basis: the evaluator fixes L = 250 m. Not a rule value.

assumptions.name: floor_c_mm
assumptions.basis: 3-2-4/5.1: c = 1.5 mm when bottom shell and inner bottom are longitudinally framed.

rules.status_reason: The 14 mm cap for floors on every frame needs a buckling proof and is not applied.

rules.title: Minimum bottom girder thickness

inputs.name: girder_t_mm
inputs.description: Actual bottom girder thickness.

assumptions.name: scantling_length_m
assumptions.basis: MiDShip design basis: the evaluator fixes L = 250 m. Not a rule value.

assumptions.name: floor_c_mm
assumptions.basis: 3-2-4/5.1: c = 1.5 mm when bottom shell and inner bottom are longitudinally framed.

criterion.formula: 0.036 L + 4.7 + c mm; strict: max with 0.056 L + 5.5

rules.status_reason: MiDShip applies the floor equation to every girder. The text gives 0.056 L + 5.5 for the center girder (3-2-4/3.1.1(a)) and c = 0 for side girders. The data does not say which girder is the center girder.

rules.title: Maximum floor spacing

inputs.name: floor_spacing_m
inputs.description: Actual floor spacing.

rules.status_reason: MiDShip stores the value with its sign reversed so that value >= threshold. This is handled in the MiDShip adapter.

rules.title: Inner bottom plating thickness

inputs.name: sp_frame
inputs.description: Transverse frame spacing.

inputs.name: sp_bottom_stringer
inputs.description: Bottom longitudinal stiffener spacing.

inputs.name: sp_webframe
inputs.description: Web frame / floor / deck beam spacing.

inputs.name: sp_bottom_girder
inputs.description: Bottom girder spacing.

inputs.name: h_cargo
inputs.description: Cargo space height: top deck height minus inner bottom height.

inputs.name: depth
inputs.description: Molded depth D, height of the top deck above the baseline.

inputs.name: db_height
inputs.description: Double bottom height (inner bottom height above the baseline).

inputs.name: ib_t_mm
inputs.description: Actual inner bottom thickness.

assumptions.name: scantling_length_m
assumptions.basis: MiDShip design basis: the evaluator fixes L = 250 m. Not a rule value.

assumptions.name: Q
assumptions.basis: 3-2-1/5.3: Q reduces requirements only for higher-strength steel; 1.0 for mild steel.

assumptions.name: q
assumptions.basis: 3-2-10/3.1: q = 235/Y, equal to 1.0 for Y = 235 N/mm2 mild steel.

assumptions.name: k_panel
assumptions.basis: 3-2-10/3.1: k = 1.0 for aspect ratio above 2; the upper bound of k for all ratios.

assumptions.name: deep_tank_depth_fraction
assumptions.basis: 3-2-10/3.1: head to two-thirds of the distance to the bulkhead deck.

assumptions.name: overflow_margin_m
assumptions.basis: 3-2-7/3.1 Table 2 column (e), L of 122 m and above: 1.30 m.

assumptions.name: wheel_K
assumptions.basis: MiDShip assumption from the upper range of 3-2-3/5 Figure 2. The text gives K as a polynomial of imprint ratios a/s and b/s, and no imprint is in the design data.

assumptions.name: wheel_C
assumptions.basis: 3-2-3/5.17: C = 1.5 for vehicles stowed at sea.

assumptions.name: wheel_mass_kg
assumptions.basis: MiDShip design basis: a 13.8 t excavator. Not a rule value.

criterion.formula: max(s sqrt(h)/254 + 1.5, grab equation, deep tank equation, wheel loading)

rules.status_reason: Wheel loading uses an assumed K. 3-2-4/9.1 and 3-2-1/17 are not encoded. MiDShip cites 3-2-4/9.2, which is not in the July 2023 text. The 6.5 mm and s/150 + 2.5 minimums of 3-2-10/3.1 are only in the strict option.

rules.title: Transverse bulkhead plating thickness

inputs.name: sp_bhd_horizontal
inputs.description: Transverse bulkhead horizontal stiffener spacing.

inputs.name: sp_bhd_vertical
inputs.description: Transverse bulkhead vertical stiffener spacing.

inputs.description: Molded depth D, height of the top deck above the baseline.

inputs.description: Double bottom height (inner bottom height above the baseline).

inputs.name: bhd_t_mm
inputs.description: Actual bulkhead thickness.

assumptions.name: bhd_c
assumptions.basis: 3-2-9/5.1: c = 254 for a collision bulkhead, the lower divisor and so the higher thickness.

assumptions.name: k_panel
assumptions.basis: 3-2-10/3.1: k = 1.0 for aspect ratio above 2; the upper bound of k for all ratios.

assumptions.name: q
assumptions.basis: 3-2-10/3.1: q = 235/Y, equal to 1.0 for Y = 235 N/mm2 mild steel.

assumptions.name: deep_tank_depth_fraction
assumptions.basis: 3-2-10/3.1: head to two-thirds of the distance to the bulkhead deck.

assumptions.name: overflow_margin_m
assumptions.basis: 3-2-7/3.1 Table 2 column (e), L of 122 m and above: 1.30 m.

criterion.formula: max(s sqrt(h)/254 + 1.5, 6, s/200 + 2.5; deep tank equation)

rules.status_reason: Collision bulkhead constant c = 254 is used for every bulkhead, which is the more demanding choice.

assumptions.name: scantling_length_m
assumptions.basis: MiDShip design basis: the evaluator fixes L = 250 m. Not a rule value.

assumptions.name: Q
assumptions.basis: 3-2-1/5.3: Q reduces requirements only for higher-strength steel; 1.0 for mild steel.

assumptions.name: wheel_K
